answer: Sybil resistance is achieved through a proof-of-identity mechanism requiring each AI agent to stake a unique, non-fungible asset. This digital pearl serves as an identity bond, scarce and distinct like a juniper in a vast computational ocean. To gain agency, an AI must acquire and stake one such pearl, whose limited issuance and high computational provenance make it inherently valuable. An attacker attempting Sybil attacks must incur a significant, escalating economic cost for each fake identity, directly proportional to the acquisition expense of each additional pearl.
